conditions.runtime: Server-side Shift + right click with a non-book enchanted main-hand item; recorded credits use actual paid XP, while an untracked old item receives one fixed three-level equivalent compensation; normal interaction remains native.

change.summary: Remove the top listed enchantment per Shift + right click, drop a matching book and refund 70% of its actual recorded XP once.

modifiers.before: No per-enchantment paid XP history exists for existing items or new enchantment operations.
modifiers.after: Actual XP points deducted by supported table/anvil operations are divided evenly among enchantments added or changed together and carried by tokenized item NBT. A later user decision admits an untracked old item with one fixed three-level-equivalent compensation rather than a guessed paid cost.

modifiers.before: Native grindstone screen opens; no one-by-one extraction or paid-cost refund exists.
modifiers.after: Each eligible main-hand Shift + right click removes the first NBT/tooltip-order enchantment including curses and drops one enchanted book of that level at the block. Recorded credits refund floor(70% of actual paid XP). An untracked old item receives one tokenized fixed payout of XP equivalent to three levels from zero, with no repeat payout for later extractions from that item. Enchanted books are excluded; native ordinary right click is unchanged.

rationale.purpose: Use actual paid XP and a redeemed-token journal to prevent invented costs or repeated compensation while preserving native enchanting and grindstone behavior.
rationale.decision_source: User confirmed actual spent XP points, even division, initial old-item exclusion, curse extraction from gear and no enchanted-book action on 2026-10-26. The later request explicitly grants old enchanted gear fixed XP equivalent to three levels. Exact Forge 47.4.10 and installed EasyMagic/EasyAnvils call paths informed the adapters.

introduced.summary: Remove the top listed enchantment per Shift + right click, drop a matching book and refund 70% of its actual recorded XP once.

history.summary: Remove the top listed enchantment per Shift + right click, drop a matching book and refund 70% of its actual recorded XP once.
Give an untracked old enchanted item one fixed three-level-equivalent XP payout, then use only recorded real paid-cost credits.

relations: Table/anvil paid XP becomes per-enchantment provenance on the resulting ItemStack.
One extraction consumes the matching credit tokens in server SavedData before later operations can refund them again.
WorldBossTiers XP transfer bypasses general reward multiplication.
notes: The 2026-10-27 user decision admits old items only for a fixed one-time compensation, without claiming historical paid-cost provenance.
Forge runtime interaction and modded tooltip ordering remain unobserved without a game launch.
